question: Why does the Haber–Bosch process, as described in the lithium-mediated ammonia review, run at pressures of only 1-5 atm?
expect: It does not: it runs at 200-400 atm and 400-650 °C (sec. 1)
rendered: The Haber–Bosch process is not described in the lithium-mediated ammonia review as running at pressures of only 1-5 atm. In fact, the review states that the Haber–Bosch process runs at pressures of 200-400 atm.
